answer: The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The beacon lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the whisper is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. By the basalt of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
